pages.text: Land 8 damaging Blood Legacy strikes, then press $(k:key.witchersbestiary.legendary_ability) with it in your main hand. The charge is yours and is spent on activation.
The cast releases a 5-block blood wave. Visible enemies take 2% of their max health as base damage and are knocked back. Large enemies and bosses resist most of the push.
During Bloodlust (10 seconds), Blood Legacy heals 20% of health damage dealt, up to 2 HP per hit and 8 HP in total. The cooldown lasts 90 seconds.
Crimson mist coils around the drawn blade during Bloodlust. Death, changing dimensions or leaving the server ends the effect.
Place the Witcher sword first in an anvil and a diamond or netherite sword second. Preview the compatible enchantments. Taking the result consumes the donor. Enchanted books still work.
